Class EventCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.server.model.card.EventCard
public class EventCard extends Object
Represents an event card that applies a game-wide effect when resolved. Events can be round events (resolved once at the end of a round) or final events (resolved only at the very end of the game).

    • EventCard

      public EventCard(String cardID, Era era, EventType type, Boolean isFinal, int priority, EventEffect eventEffect)
      Parameters:
      cardID - unique identifier (e.g. "E_001")
      era - the era this event belongs to
      type - the event type, used to match building observers
      isFinal - true if this event is resolved only at game end
      priority - resolution order among simultaneous events (lower = first)
      eventEffect - the effect applied to all players when this event fires

    • applyEventEffect

      public EffectOutcome applyEventEffect(List<Player> players, List<EventObserver> eventObservers)
      Applies this event's effect to all players and notifies registered EventObservers before and after resolution.
      Parameters:
      players - all players affected by the event
      eventObservers - building effects observing event resolutions
      Returns:
      an EffectOutcome aggregating all resource deltas (from the event and observers)
